description:
72 models sit in the app/Models kernel; the modular-monolith ADR says some belong inside the module that owns them.

Scope by the ADR's own rule rather than by count: a model qualifies when it is used almost entirely by one module and by fewer than a handful of consumers overall. Hub models — Site, Server, Organization, User, SiteBinding — stay in the kernel permanently. EdgeDeployment is central rather than a leaf and needs its own pass, not a bulk move.

Note that tests/Unit/ModuleBoundaryTest.php does not validate model placement. It only rejects Module-to-presentation-shell dependencies, so it will not catch a bad move here.
title: Move qualifying leaf models into their modules
